messages:
maria: Incidentbot didn't page oncall during a ~10m window for svc-auth, customers reported auth failures. Noticed from SLO alert.

samir: confirming, I see a spike in 503s around 12:02 UTC. Incidentbot shows suppressed pages: reason=quiet_window

jane: @maria can you paste the channel thread? do we have PagerDuty pages? :eyes:

incidentbot: [automated] Suppression applied to svc-auth pages: rule_id=quiet-window-ps, ttl=600s, matched_tags=[maintenance:false, severity:high]

kevin: that suppression rule shouldn't match production traffic. looks like notify-proxy stripped routing headers so incidentbot couldn't classify route.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T12:00Z updated notify-proxy config: STRIP_ROUTING_HEADERS=true for that rollout

samir: infra, can you confirm rollback or patch? this is causing misses.

maria: customers are hitting login errors and a few support tickets came in. need triage and impact assessment.

jane: @oncall-tier1 are you free to lead triage? if not, @kevin?

oncall-tier1: I'm available, joining war room: https://zoom.company/warroom

kevin: logs from notify-proxy show X-RD-ROUTE header removal around 12:01-12:03. sample:
```
INFO 12:02:15 notify-proxy req_id=abc123 headers={Authorization:***, Host:auth.internal}
DEBUG removed_headers=[X-RD-ROUTE]
```

samir: mitigation plan: re-enable header passthrough, restart notify-proxy, force incidentbot to re-evaluate suppressed queue.

maria: doing reconfigure now — commands:
```
kubectl set env deploy/notify-proxy STRIP_ROUTING_HEADERS=false -n infra
kubectl rollout restart deploy/notify-proxy -n infra
```

ops-bot: rollout initiated for notify-proxy (namespace: infra). status: progressing

incidentbot: [automated] re-evaluating suppressed pages for svc-auth; previously_suppressed=4, pages_now=4 -> dispatching to oncall

oncall-tier1: received pages. triage underway. customer impact: auth failures (login) intermittent for ~7 minutes, peak error rate ~12% for 30s bursts. marking P1.

jane: assigning postmortem owner — @samir volunteered?

samir: I'll own the postmortem and action items.

maria: immediate action items: 1) add unit test for incidentbot routing when headers missing, 2) add CI check for notify-proxy deploy flags, 3) backfill missed pages to PD for audit.

kevin: created issue RED-1234 for runbook updates and deploy guard rails: https://issues.company/RED-1234

maria: notify support/customer-success to send template notice to affected customers. I'll draft message.

jane: also adding monitoring tweak: alert threshold lowered to page on svc-auth 5xx spike >1% for 1m to avoid suppression overshadowing.

oncall-tier1: logs and timeline attached in war room. continuing to monitor.

maria: thanks all — will move full writeup to #postmortems and link PD incidents. closing war room in 10m unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:
